Can a person declared a foreigner in India claim the same legal protections as someone accused of a criminal offence?
The Gauhati High Court reiterated that proceedings before Foreigners Tribunals are civil in nature, not criminal prosecutions. In a November 10 ruling concerning Hamida Begum, the Court explained the consequences of being declared a foreigner, including detention and deportation under the Foreigners Act, 1946.
The Court also highlighted that 1,16,946 declared foreigners remain absconding across Assam.
